$comment: Repair axis (Phase 5, differentiator E). iFixit: the device-category endpoint of the iFixit API (robots.txt allows /api/2.0/wikis*; it disallows /api/2.0/search, see docs/CHALLENGES.md C-2). The brand's category is looked up by name; at most maxDevices of its device sub-categories (the last ones listed, which on iFixit are the newest models of a numbered line) are read for guide counts and the repairability score.

frIndex.$comment: French repairability index (Phase 12, ADR-027, docs/SOURCES.md). The data.gouv.fr dataset search API is paged (next_page, at most maxPages pages of pageSize). Only datasets whose licence id is in openLicences are read and scored; any other licence (in practice 'notspecified') is pointed to under 'What we could not check' and its CSV is never fetched. static.data.gouv.fr's robots.txt disallows /resources, so when a resource URL is disallowed the CSV is read from data.gouv.fr's tabular API export (tabularCsvUrl, no robots.txt restriction) instead (docs/CHALLENGES.md C-12.1). lowThreshold: mean note_ir (0-10) below which repair.fr_index_low is emitted (director's value).
